title: Measure before you trust
description: Before I ship a retrieval or ranking change, I want a labeled set of queries to compare it against.

title: Reliability beats cleverness
description: I'd rather have a simple design that fails loudly than a clever one that fails silently.

title: Humans own irreversible decisions
description: For hiring decisions, client emails, and anything hard to undo, the model drafts and a person confirms.

title: Prefer deterministic over magical
description: LLMs suggest. Regular code validates the output, computes the scores, and decides what gets saved.

title: Keep the surface small
description: I extract shared code the third time I repeat it. Building a framework too early costs more than a bit of duplication.
